augmenters.description: A list of {@link DiagramAugmenter}s to be used, such as {@link DiagramRandomCropper}

iouThreshold.description: IOU (Intersection over Union) threshold above which should be considered as a true label

stepsPerEpoch.description: The number of steps per training epoch. Each step processes {@link trainBatchSize} of samples.

patience.description: The number of epochs with no validation score improvement after which training will be stopped

numReuse.description: Number of times an sample can be continuously reused for training

proposer.description: Trained region proposer for the symbol detector

trainFromScratch.description:
If true, the pipe will be trained from scratch. If false, the pipe will load a pre-trained h5 file and
fine-tune it.

title: Parameters controlling the model training behavior of an region classifier.
name: RegionClassifierTrainingSpec
